title: Remote viewing continued under OSAP

tellings.quote: on. And I mean, you even if you read skim marketers at the Pentagon, it was definitely still going on in the context of Osap

plain: Remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe distant places or things using the mind alone, was still being studied inside a later Pentagon-funded program known as OSAP, according to Michels. He says this himself and points to the book Skinwalkers at the Pentagon, saying that even a quick skim of it shows the work "was definitely still going on in the context of Osap." If true, it would mean the government kept exploring psychic abilities well after it was said to have stopped.
